name: lightning-mcqueen
title_zh: 从摸清领域到跑通验证，一次只讲一个故事
tagline_zh: 接手陌生代码库时最怕边猜边改：它先逼你把领域词汇、边界和验收条件讲成一个完整故事，再动第一行代码。
tagline_en: Before touching unfamiliar code, it forces you to tell one coherent story of the domain, boundaries and.
desc_en: Ka-chow: from domain discovery to verified implementation, one story at a time.
why_zh: 它把「理解」当成可交付物：故事讲不圆就不许开工，验证跑不通就不算讲完。
why_en: It treats understanding as a deliverable: no coherent story, no coding; no passing verification, no done.
limit_zh: 它只适合从零或半途接手、且你能跟人反复对话澄清的仓库；纯脚本小改、需求已写死、或没人有空回答领域问题的场景。
limit_en: Only for repos you're inheriting and can discuss with someone; tiny script edits or fully-specified tasks will stall at the storytelling step.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Domain discovery to verified build, one story at a time
